description: Assess whether a GitHub repository is trustworthy, overhyped, star-inflated, or safe to adopt. Use when the user shares a GitHub URL, owner/repo slug, library name, trending project, or asks whether an open-source project is legit, trustworthy, fake-starred, production-ready, or worth using. Produces an evidence-backed credibility report with a verdict, weighted score, and adoption recommendation.
